claim: Circulating 50 State Quarters production figures are reported for the United States Mints at Denver and Philadelphia. Coins minted for numismatic bags, rolls, and boxes are produced in the circulating departments of those facilities and may be shown in circulating totals.
opposite: All circulating 50 State Quarters for commerce were struck exclusively at the San Francisco Mint with an S mint mark.
queries: 50 State Quarters Program Production Denver Philadelphia circulating departments numismatic bags rolls
